readings.title: 05. His Supplication for himself and the People under his Guardianship
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: يامَنْ لاتَنْقَضِي عَجَائِبُ عَظَمَتِهِ،
records.transliteration: yamann la tanqadi ʿaja'ibu ʿazhamatih
records.english_text: O He the wonders of whose mightiness will never end!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاحْجُبْنَا عَنِ الالْحَادِ فِي عَظَمَتِكَ.
records.transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-aḥjubnā ʿani al-ilhādī fī ʿaẓamatika
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and prevent us from deviation concerning Thy mightiness!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man lā tantahī muddatu mulkih
records.english_text: O He the term of whose kingdom will never cease!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَعْتِقْ رِقَابَنَا مِنْ نَقِمَتِك.
records.transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa'a'tiq riqa'bana min naqimati-ka
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and release our necks from Thy vengeance!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man lā tafnā khazā'inu raḥmatihi
records.english_text: O He the treasuries of whose mercy will never be exhausted!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْ لَنا نَصِيباً فِي رَحْمَتِكَ.
records.transliteration: ṣallī ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-jʿal lana naṣīban fī raḥmatik
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and appoint for us a portion of Thy mercy!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الابْصَارُ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man tanqaṭiʿu dūna rūyatihi al-abṣārُ،
records.english_text: O He whom eyes fall short of seeing!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَدْنِنَا إلَى قُرْبِكَ.
records.transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ʾālih wa ʾadnina ila qurbika
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and bring us close to Thy nearness!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الاخْطَارُ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man taṣghuru ʿinda khaṭarihi al-aḫṭār
records.english_text: O He before whose greatness all great things are small!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَكَرِّمْنَا عَلَيْكَ.
records.transliteration: ṣallī ʿalā muḥammad wa-ālih wa karrimnā ʿalayk
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and give us honour with Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الاخْبَارِ،
records.transliteration: wayā man taẓharu ʿindahu bawāṭin al-akhbār
records.english_text: O He to whom all hidden tidings are manifest!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَلاَ تَفْضَحْنَا لَدَيْكَ.
records.transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih walā tafḍaḥnā ladayka
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and expose us not before Thee!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهّابِيْنَ بِهِبَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا وَحْشَةَ الْقَاطِعِين بِصِلَتِكَ ، حَتّى لا نَرْغَبَ إلَى أحَد مَعَ بَذْلِكَ، وَلاَ نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أحَد مَعَ فَضْلِكَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma aghnina ʿan hibati al-wahhābīna bihibatika wākfinā waḥshata al-qāṭiʿīn bi ṣilatika ḥattá lā narghaba ʾilá ʾaḥad maʿa bazlik walā nastawḥiša min ʾaḥad maʿa faḍlika
records.english_text: O God, remove our need for the gifts of the givers through Thy gift, spare us the loneliness of those who break off through Thy joining, that we may beseech no one along with Thy free giving, that we may feel lonely at no one's absence along with Thy bounty!

records.arabic_text: اللهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَكِدْ لَنَا وَلا تَكِدْ عَلَيْنَا، وَامْكُرْ لَنَا وَلاَ تَمْكُرْ بنَا، وَأدِلْ لَنَا وَلاَ تُدِلْ مِنّا.
records.transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih wa kid lana wa la takid ʿalayna wamkur lanā walā tamkur banā wa adil lana wa la tudil minna
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, scheme for us, not against us, devise to our benefit, not to our loss, give the turn to prevail to us, not to others!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إلَيْكَ، وَلاَ تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إنّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تُقَرِّبُهُ إلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waqinā minka, waḥfiẓnā bika, wahdīnā ilayk walā tubāʿidnā ʿanka inna man taqihī yaslam wa man tahdihī yaʿlam, wa man tuqarribuhu ilayka yaghnam
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, protect us from Thyself, safeguard us through Thyself, guide us to Thyself, and take us not far from Thyself! he whom Thou protectest stays safe, he whom Thou guidest knows, and he whom Thou bringest near Thyself takes the spoils.

records.arabic_text: الّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْفِنَا حَدَّ نَوائِبِ الزَّمَانِ، وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشّيطانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wakfinā ḥadda nawāʾibi al-zamān wa sharra maṣāʾid al-shayṭān wa marārata ṣawlati al-sulṭān
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and spare us the cutting edge of time's turning changes, the evil of Satan's snares, and the bitterness of the sovereign's aggression!

records.arabic_text: اللّهُمَّ إنَّما يَكْتَفِي الْمُكْتَفُونَ بِفَضْـل قُوَّتِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى محَمَّد وَآلِهِ ،وَاكْفِنَا
records.transliteration: allāhumma innamā yaktafī al-muktafūna bifaḍl quwwatika faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih, wakfinā
records.english_text: O God, the spared are spared only through the bounty of Thy strength, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and spare us!

records.arabic_text: وَإنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ و اعطنا
records.transliteration: wa innamā yuʿti al-muʿtuun min faḍli jidatika fa salli `ala muhammad wa alihi wa 'atina
records.english_text: The givers give only through the bounty of Thy wealth, so bless Muhammad and his Household and give to us!

records.arabic_text: وَإنمَا يَهْتَدِي الْمُهْتَدُونَ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى محمّد وَآلِهِ وَاهْدِنَا .
records.transliteration: wa innamā yahdī al-muhtadūna binūri wajhika faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa ahdi-nā
records.english_text: The guided are guided only by the light of Thy face, so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide us!

records.arabic_text: اللّهُمَّ إنّكَ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ خِذْلانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ، وَمَنْ أعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْـعُ الْمَانِعِينَ، وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إضْلاَلُ المُضِلِّيْنَ.
records.transliteration: allahumma innaka man waliyta lam yadurruhu khidhlanu al-khazileen wa man aʿtayta lam yanqus-hu manʿu al-maniʿīn wa-man hadayta lam yughwih iḍlalu al-muḍillīn
records.english_text: O God, he whom Thou befriendest will not be injured by the abandonment of the abandoners, he to whom Thou givest will not be diminished by the withholding of the withholders, he whom Thou guidest will not be misled by the misguidance of the misguiders.

records.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَأغْنِنَا عَنْ غَيْرِكَ بِإرْفَادِكَ وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا سَبِيلَ الْحَقِّ بِـإرْشَادِكَ.
records.transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih, wa amnaʿnā biʿizzika, min ʿibādik waʾaghninā ʿan ghayrika biʾirfādika wasluk bina sabil alhaqq bi irshadik
records.english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, defend us from Thy servants through Thy might, free us from need for other than Thee through Thy support, and make us travel the path of the Truth through Thy right guidance!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَانْطِلاَقَ أَلْسِنَتِنَا فِي وَصْفِ مِنَّتِكَ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wajʿal salāmata qulūbinā fī dhikri ʿaẓamatika wa farāgha abdāninā fī shukri niʿmatika wa-inṭilāqa ʾalsinatina fī waṣfi minnatika
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and put the soundness of our hearts into the remembrance of Thy mightiness, the idleness of our bodies into giving thanks for Thy favour, and the flow of our tongues into the description of Thy kindness!

records.arabic_text: أللَهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ دُعَاتِكَ الدّاعِينَ إلَيْكَ وَهُدَاتِكَ الدَّالّينَ عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْ خَاصَّتِكَ الْخَاصِّينَ لَدَيْكَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wajʿalna min duʿaatika addāʿīna ilayk wa hudatika al-dālīn ʿalayka wa min khaṣṣatika al-khāṣṣīna ladayka
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and make us one of Thy summoners who summon to Thee, Thy guiders who direct to Thee, and Thy special friends whom Thou hast singled out!

records.arabic_text: يَا أرْحَمَ ألرَّاحِمِينَ .
records.transliteration: yā ar-raḥmaan
records.english_text: O Most Merciful of the merciful!

readings.title: 06. His Supplication in the Morning and Evening
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ، وَمَيَّزَ بَيْنَهُمَا بِقُدْرَتِهِ، وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً، وَأَمَداً مَمْدُوداً ،
records.transliteration: al-ḥamdulillāhi al-ladhī khalaqa al-layla wa al-nahāra bi quwwatih wa mayyaza baynahuma bi qudratihi wa jaʿala li-kulli wāḥidin minhumā ḥaddan maḥdūdan, wa ʾamadan mamdūdan
records.english_text: Praise belongs to God, who created night and day through His strength, set them apart through His power, and appointed for each a determined limit and a drawn-out period.

records.arabic_text: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ، وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِير مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ فِيمَا يَغْـذُوهُمْ بِـهِ وَيُنْشئُهُمْ عَلَيْـهِ،
records.transliteration: yu'liju kulla wahidin minhuma fi sahibihi wa yu'lijus sahibahu feehi bitaqdeer minhu lil'ibad fīmā yaghḍūhum bihī wa yunshuʾuhum ʿalayh
records.english_text: He makes each of the two enter into its companion, and makes its companion enter into it, as an ordainment from Him for His servants in that through which He feeds them and with which He makes them grow.

records.arabic_text: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْـلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيْهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ، وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ، فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ جَمَاماً وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
records.transliteration: fakhalaqa lahumu allayla liyaskunu fihi min harakat al-taʿabi wa nahạðāti al-naşabi, wa jaʿalahu libāsan liyalbasū min rāhatihi wa manāmihi fayakūna dhālika jamāman wa quwwatan, wa liyanālu bihi lazzatan wa shahwatan
records.english_text: He created for them the night, "that they might rest in it" (10:67) from tiring movements and wearisome exertions and He made it a garment for them that they might be clothed in its ease and its sleep, that it might be for them refreshment and strength, that they might reach therein pleasure and passion.

records.arabic_text: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهارَ مُبْصِراً لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا إلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ، طَلَباً لِمَا فِيـهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ، وَدَرَكُ الاجِلِ فِيْ اُخْراهُمْ. بِكُلِّ ذلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأنَهُمْ،
records.transliteration: wa khalaqa lahumun-nahara mubṣirā liyabtaghū fīhi min faḍlih waliyatasabbabu ila rizqihi, wayasraḥu fi ardhihi ṭalaban limā fīhi naylul-ʿājili min dunyāhum wa daraka al-ajli fee ukhrahum. bikulli dhalika yuslihu sha'anahum
records.english_text: He created for them the daytime, "giving sight, that they might seek within it of His bounty" (ref. 17:12) find the means to His provision, and roam freely in His earth, searching for that through which to attain the immediate in their life in this world and to achieve the deferred in their life to come. Through all of this He sets right their situation,

records.arabic_text: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِـهِ، وَمَنَازِلِ فُـرُوضِهِ وَمَوَاقِعِ أَحْكَامِهِ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
records.transliteration: wa yablu akhbarahum wa yanzuru kayfa hum fi awqati ta'atih wa manazili furūdhihi wa mawāqiʿi aḥkāmihi li-yajziya alladhina asa'u bima 'amilu wa yajziya alladhina ahsanu bil-husna
records.english_text: tries their records, and watches their state in the times for obeying Him, the waystations of His obligations, and the places of His ordinances, that He may repay those who do evil with what they have done and repay those who do good with goodness.

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَافَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الإصْبَاحِ، وَمَتَّعْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ ضَوْءِ النَّهَارِ، وَبَصَّرْتَنَا مِنْ مَطَالِبِ الاقْوَاتِ، وَوَقَيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنْ طَوارِقِ الآفاتِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma fala(k)a al-ḥamdu ʿalā mā fala(q)ta lanā mina al-ṣubḥ wa mattaʿtanā bihī min ḍawʾi al-nahār wa baṣṣartanā min maṭālibi al-aqwāt wa waqaytanā fīhi min ṭawāriqi al-āfāt
records.english_text: O God, to Thee belongs praise for the sky Thou hast split into dawn for us, giving us to enjoy thereby the brightness of daytime, showing us sought-after nourishments, and protecting us from the striking of blights.

records.arabic_text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الاَشْياءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ: سَمَاؤُها وَأَرْضُهَا وَمَا بَثَثْتَ فِي كُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلا فِي الْهَواءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرى
records.transliteration: aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥatil ashya'u kulluhā bi jumlatihā laka: samāʾuhā wa arḍuhā wa mā baththta fī kulli wāḥid minhumā sākinuhu wa mutaḥarrikuhu wa muqīmuhu wa shākhisuhu wa mā ʿalā fī al-hawāʾ wa mā kanna taḥta al-tharra
records.english_text: In the morning we and all things, every one, rise for Thee, the heaven and the earth and what Thou hast scattered in each, the still and the moving, the resident and the journeying, what towers up in the air and what hides under the ground.

records.arabic_text: أَصْبَحْنَا فِي قَبْضَتِكَ يَحْوِينَا مُلْكُكَ وَسُلْطَانُكَ وَتَضُمُّنَا مَشِيَّتُكَ،
records.transliteration: ʾaṣbaḥnā fī qabḍatika yaḥwīnā mulkuka wa sulṭānuka wa taḍummunā mashīyatuka
records.english_text: We rise in the morning in Thy grasp: Thy kingdom and authority contain us and Thy will embraces us.

records.arabic_text: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِيْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
records.transliteration: wa nataṣarrafu ʿan amrika, wa nataqallabu fi tadbiirika
records.english_text: We move about by Thy command and turn this way and that through Thy governing.

records.arabic_text: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الامْرِ إلاّ مَا قَضَيْتَ وَلا مِنَ الْخَيْـرِ إلا مَـا أَعْطَيْتَ.
records.transliteration: laysa lana min al-amri illa ma qadayta wa laa min al-khayri illa ma a'tayta
records.english_text: We own nothing of the affair except what Thou hast decreed and nothing of the good except what Thou hast given.

records.arabic_text: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ ،
records.transliteration: wa-ha-dha yawmun ha-dithun ja-didun, wa-huwa 'alay-na sha-hidun 'a-tidun
records.english_text: This is a fresh, new day, over us a ready witness.

records.arabic_text: إنْ أحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْد، وَإِنْ أسَأنا فارَقَنا بِذَمّ
records.transliteration: ʾin aḥsannā waddaʿanā biḥamd, waʾin asaʾanā faraqanā bidhimm
records.english_text: If we do good, it will take leave from us with praise, and if we do evil, it will part from us in blame.

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَد وَآلِـهِ وَارْزُقْنَـا حُسْنَ مُصَاحَبَتِهِ وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْ سُوْءِ مُفَارَقَتِهِ بِارْتِكَابِ جَرِيرَة، أَوِ اقْتِرَافِ صَغِيرَة أوْ كَبِيرَة.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa arzuqna husna muṣāḥabatihī wa aʿṣimnā min suu'i mufaraqatihi bi-irtikabi jarirah aw iqtiraf sagheeratan aw kabeeratan
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, provide us with the day's good companionship and preserve us against parting from it badly by doing a misdeed or committing a sin, whether small or great!

records.arabic_text: وَأجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَناتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ.
records.transliteration: wa-ajzil lana fihi min al-hasanat wa-akhlinā fihi mina al-sayyi'at
records.english_text: Make our good deeds within it plentiful empty us therein of evil deeds,

records.arabic_text: وَامْلا لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْداً وَشُكْراً وَأجْراً وَذُخْراً وَفَضْلاً وَإحْسَاناً.
records.transliteration: wa-amla lana ma bayna ṭarafayhi ḥamdan wa-shukran wa-ajran wa-ẓukhran wa-faḍlan wa-iḥsanan
records.english_text: and fill what lies between its two sides for us with praise and thanksgiving, wages and stores, bounty and beneficence!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ يسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا، وَامْلا لَنَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا صَحَائِفَنَا.
records.transliteration: allāhumma yassir ʿalā al-kirām al-kātibīna maʾūnatanā wa-amla lana min hasanatina saha'ifana
records.english_text: O God, ease our burden on the Noble Writers, fill our pages for us with our good deeds,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا عِنْدَهُمْ بِسُوءِ أَعْمَالِنَا.
records.transliteration: walā tukhzinā ʿindahum bisūʾi aʿmālinā
records.english_text: and degrade us not before them with our evil works!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظّاً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ، وَنَصِيباً مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْق مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ijʿal lana fī kulli sāʿatin min sāʿātihī ḥazzaan min ʿibādik wa-naṣībān min shukrika wa-shāhida ṣidqan min malāʾikatika
records.english_text: O God, appoint for us in each of the day's hours a share from Thy servants, a portion of giving thanks to Thee, and a truthful witness among Thy angels!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهَّمَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ، وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أيْمَانِنَا وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا، وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ نَوَاحِيْنَا حِفْظاً عَاصِماً مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ هَادِياً إلَى طَاعَتِكَ مُسْتَعْمِلاً لِمَحَبَّتِكَ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa aḥfaẓnā min bayni ʾaydīnā wa min khalfinā wa ʿan ʾaymāninā wa ʿan shamāʾil wa min jamiʿi nawāhīnā ḥifẓan ʿāṣiman min maʿṣiyatika hādiyān ilā ṭāʿatika mustaʿmilan li-maḥabbatika
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and safeguard us from before us and behind us, from our right hands and our left hands and from all our directions, a safeguarding that will preserve from disobeying Thee, guide to obeying Thee, and be employed for Thy love!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هذا ولَيْلَتِنَا هذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أيّامِنَا لاسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْـرَانِ الشَرِّ وَشُكْـرِ ألنِّعَمِ وَاتّبَـاعِ السُّنَنِ وَمُجَانَبَةِ البِدَعِ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa waffiqnā fī yawminā hādhā wa laylatinā hādhīhi wa fī jamiʿi ayyāminā la astiʿmaalil khayri wahijraanish sharrish shukrinniʿami wa at-tibāʿi as-sunnah wa mujānabati al-bidʿi
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and give us success in this day of ours, this night of ours, and in all our days, to employ the good, stay away from the evil, give thanks for favours, follow the Sunna's norms, avoid innovations,

records.arabic_text: وَالأمْرِ بِـالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهيِ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَحِياطَةِ الإسْلاَمِ وَانْتِقَاصِ الْبَاطِلِ وَإذْلالِهِ وَنُصْرَةِ الْحَقِّ وَإعْزَازِهِ ، وَإرْشَادِ الضَّالِّ ، وَمُعَاوَنَةِ الضَّعِيفِ وَإدْرَاكِ اللَّهِيْفِ.
records.transliteration: wal-amri bil-maʿrūfi wan-nahyi ʿani-l-munkari waḥiyāṭi al-islāmi wa intiqāṣi al-bāṭili wa ʾidhlālihi wa-nuṣraṭi al-haqqi wa-iʿzāzihi, wa-irshādi al-ḍālli wa muʿāwanati al-ḍaʿīfī wa idrāki allahīf
records.english_text: enjoin good behaviour, forbid the disapproved, defend Islam, diminish falsehood and abase it, help the truth and exalt it, guide the misguided, assist the weak, and reach out to the troubled!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْهُ أيْمَنَ يَوْم عَهِدْنَاهُ ، وَأَفْضَلَ صَاحِب صَحِبْنَاهُ ، وَخَيْرَ وَقْت ظَلِلْنَا فِيْهِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wajʿalhu aymana yawm ʿahidnāhu wa-afḍala ṣāḥibi ṣaḥibnāh wa khayra waqtin ẓalilna fiih
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and make this the most fortunate day we have known, the most excellent companion we have accompanied, and the best time in which we have lingered!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْـلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ وأَشْكَـرَهُمْ لِمَا أوْلَيْتَ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ وَأقْوَمَهُمْ بِمَـا شَرَعْتَ مِنْ شَرَائِعِكَ ، وَأَوْقَفَهُمْ عَمَّا حَذَّرْتَ مِنْ نَهْيِكَ.
records.transliteration: wa-aj'alna min arḍā man marrā ʿalayhi al-laylu wa al-nahāru min jumlati khalqika wa-ashkharahum lima awlayta min niʿamika wa aqwaamahum bimaa sharaʿta min sharaaʾiki wa aqfahum ʿamma haddarthahum min nahyika
records.english_text: Place us among the most satisfied of all Thy creatures whom night and day have passed by, the most thankful of them for the favours Thou hast done, the firmest of them in the laws Thou hast set down in the Shari'a, and the most unyielding of them toward the prohibited acts against which Thou hast cautioned!

records.arabic_text: اللَهُمَّ إنِّي اشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيداً وَاُشْهِدُ سَمَاءكَ وَأَرْضَكَ وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُما مِنْ مَلائِكَتِـكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا ، وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا ، أنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أنْتَ اللهُ الِذَّي
records.transliteration: allāhumma innī ash-haduka wa kafā bika shahīdan wa ushhidu samā'aka wa arḍaka wa-man 'askan-ta-hu-ma min mala'ikatika wa-sa'iri khalqika fi yawmi ha-tha wasāʿatī hadhihi, wa laylatī hadhihi, wa mustaqarri hadha 'anni ash-hadu annaka anta allah al-ladhi..
records.english_text: O God, I call Thee to witness - and Thou art sufficient witness - and I call Thy heaven and Thy earth to witness and Thy angels and Thy other creatures who inhabit them in this my day, this my hour, this my night, and this my resting place, that I bear witness that Thou art God,

records.arabic_text: لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِـالْقِسْطِ ، عَدْلٌ فِي الْحُكْم ، رَؤُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ ، مَالِكُ المُلْكِ رَحِيمٌ بِالْخَلْقِ ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
records.transliteration: lā ilāha illā anta qā'im bil-qisṭ ʿadlun fi al-ḥukm, raʾūfun bil-ʿibād māliku al-mulki raḥīmun bil-khalqi waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasuluka wa khīratuka min khalaqika
records.english_text: other than whom there is no god, Upholding justice, Equitable in judgement, "Clement to the servants" (2:207), "Master of the kingdom" (3:26), Compassionate to the creatures, and that Muhammad is Thy servant and Thy messenger, Thy chosen from among Thy creatures.

records.arabic_text: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بالنُّصْحِ لاُِمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
records.transliteration: ḥammaltahu risālatuka fa'addāhā wa'amartahu bil-nuṣḥi li'ummatihi fanasaḥa lahā
records.english_text: Thou didst charge him with Thy message and he delivered it; Thou didst command him to counsel his community and he counselled it.

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ أكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih akthara mā ṣallayta ʿalā aḥad min khalqik
records.english_text: O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household more than Thou hast blessed any of Thy creatures!

records.arabic_text: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيائِـكَ عَنْ أمَّتِهِ.
records.transliteration: wa ātihī ʿannā afḍala mā ātayta aḥadan min ʿibādika wa-ajzihī ʿannā afḍala wa-akrama mā jazayta aḥadan min anbiyāʾika ʿan ummatihi
records.english_text: Give him for our sake the best Thou hast given any of Thy servants, and repay him on our behalf better and more generously than Thou hast repaid any of Thy prophets on behalf of his community!

records.arabic_text: إنَّـكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَـافِر لِلْعَظِيمِ ، وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ مِنْ كُلِّ رَحِيم ،
records.transliteration: 'innaka 'anta al-mannān bil-jasīmi al-ghāfir lil-'aẓīm wa anta arḥamu min kulli rahim
records.english_text: Thou art All-kind with immensity, the Forgiver of the great, and Thou art more merciful than every possessor of mercy!

records.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ الأَخْيَارِ الانْجَبِينَ.
records.transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih al-ṭayyibīna al-ṭāhirīna al-akh'yār al-anjabin
records.english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure, the chosen, the most distinguished!

readings.title: 07. When Faced with a Worrisome Task
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ ،
records.transliteration: yā man tuḥallu bihī ʿuqadu al-makārih
records.english_text: O He through whom the knots of detested things are untied!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
records.transliteration: wayā man yufthaʾu bihi ḥaddu al-shadaʾid
records.english_text: O He through whom the cutting edge of hardships is blunted!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man yultamassu minhu al-makhraj ilā rūḥi al-faraj
records.english_text: O He from whom is begged the outlet to the freshness of relief!

records.arabic_text: ذَلَّتْ لِقُدْرَتِـكَ الصِّعَابُ وَتَسَبَّبَتْ بِلُطْفِكَ الاسْبَابُ ، وَجَرى بِقُدْرَتِكَ الْقَضَاءُ وَمَضَتْ عَلَى إرَادَتِكَ الاشْياءُ ،
records.transliteration: ḏallat li-qudratika al-ṣṣiʿāb wa tasabbabat bilutfika al-asbabu wa jarra bi-qudratika al-qada' wa-madat ʿala irādatika al-ashyāʾu
records.english_text: Intractable affairs yield to Thy power, means are made ready by Thy gentleness, the decree goes into effect through Thy power, and all things proceed according to Thy desire.

records.arabic_text: فَهْيَ بِمَشِيَّتِكَ دُونَ قَوْلِكَ مُؤْتَمِرَةٌ ، وَبِإرَادَتِكَ دُونَ نَهْيِكَ مُنْزَجِرَةٌ.
records.transliteration: fa-hiya bi-mashiyyatika duna qawlika mu'tamiratun wa bi-irādatika dūna nahyika munzajirah
records.english_text: By Thy desire they follow Thy command without Thy word and by Thy will they obey Thy bans without Thy prohibition.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الْمَدْعُوُّ لِلْمُهِمَّاتِ ، وَأَنْتَ الْمَفزَعُ فِي الْمُلِمَّاتِ ،
records.transliteration: anta al-madʿū lilmuhimmāt wa-anta al-mafzau fi al-mulimmat
records.english_text: Thou art the supplicated in worries and the place of flight in misfortunes;

records.arabic_text: لاَيَنْدَفِعُ مِنْهَا إلاّ مَا دَفَعْتَ ، وَلا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إلاّ مَا كَشَفْتَ.
records.transliteration: lā yandafiʿu minha illā mā dafaʿta walā yankašifu minhā illā mā kašafta
records.english_text: none of them is repelled unless Thou repellest, and none is removed unless Thou removest.

records.arabic_text: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ ، وَأَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ ،
records.transliteration: waqad nazala biyya rabbī mā qad tak'adaniyya thiqluhu wa'alamma biy mā qad bahathanī ḥamluhu
records.english_text: Upon me has come down, My Lord, something whose weight burdens me and upon me has fallen something whose carrying oppresses me.

records.arabic_text: وَبِقُدْرَتِكَ أَوْرَدْتَهُ عَلَيَّ وَبِسُلْطَانِكَ وَجَّهْتَهُ إليَّ.
records.transliteration: wa bi-qudratika awradtahu ʿalayya wa bisulṭānik(a) wajjah(t)a(hu) ʾilayy(a)
records.english_text: Through Thy power Thou hast brought it down upon me and through Thy authority Thou hast turned it toward me.

records.arabic_text: فَلاَ مُصْدِرَ لِمَا أوْرَدْتَ ، وَلاَ صَارِفَ لِمَا وَجَّهْتَ ، وَلاَ فَاتِحَ لِمَا أغْلَقْتَ ، وَلاَ مُغْلِقَ لِمَا فَتَحْتَ ،
records.transliteration: fala musdar lima awradta wa lā ṣārifa limā wajjah-ta walā fātihalimā aghlaqta wa laa mughliqa lima fatahta
records.english_text: None can send away what Thou hast brought, none can deflect what Thou hast turned, none can open what Thou hast closed, none can close what Thou hast opened,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ مُيَسِّرَ لِمَا عَسَّرْتَ، وَلاَ نَاصِرَ لِمَنْ خَذَلْتَ
records.transliteration: walā muya'ssira limā ʿassart walā nāṣira liman khaḍalt
records.english_text: none can make easy what Thou hast made difficult, none can help him whom Thou hast abandoned.

records.arabic_text: فَصَلَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ، وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ ، وَاكْسِرْ عَنِّيْ سُلْطَانَ الْهَمِّ بِحَوْلِكَ ، وَأَنِلْيني حُسْنَ ألنَّظَرِ فِيمَا شَكَوْتُ ،
records.transliteration: faṣalla ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waftaḥ liyā, yā rabbi, bāba al-faraji biṭawlik wakssir ʿannī sultāna alhammi biḥawlika wa'anilni husna al-naẓari fi ma shakawtu
records.english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, open for me, my Lord, the door of relief through Thy graciousness, break from me the authority of worry by Thy strength, confer the beauty of Thy gaze upon my complaint,

records.arabic_text: وَأذِقْنِي حَلاَوَةَ الصُّنْعِ فِيمَا سَاَلْتُ.
records.transliteration: wa'adhiqni halawata al-sun'i feema saaltu
records.english_text: let me taste the sweetness of benefaction in what I ask,

records.arabic_text: وَهَبْ لي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً.
records.transliteration: wa habli min ladunka rahmatan wa farajan hani'an wa-jaʾl li min ʿindika makhrajā waḥiyyā
records.english_text: give me from Thyself mercy and wholesome relief, and appoint for me from Thyself a quick way out!

records.arabic_text: وَلا تَشْغَلْنِي بالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ.
records.transliteration: wa lā tašġalnī bi-l-ahtimām ʿan taʿāhudi furūḍika wa istiʿmāli sunnatika
records.english_text: Distract me not through worry from observing Thy obligations and acting in accordance with Thy prescriptions.

records.arabic_text: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً ، وَامْتَلاتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَـدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً ، وَأنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ بِهِ ، وَدَفْعِ مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ ،
records.transliteration: faqad ḍiqtu limā nazala bī yā rabbidharaʿan wa 'imtalat bi-ḥamli mā ḥadatha ʿalayya hammāً waanta alqadiru ʿala kashfi ma munitu bihi wa-dafʿi mā waqaʿtu fīh
records.english_text: My capacity has been straitened, my Lord, by what has come down on me, and I am filled with worry by carrying what has happened to me, while Thou hast power to remove what has afflicted me and to repel that into which I have fallen.

records.arabic_text: فَافْعَلْ بِي ذلِـكَ وَإنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ ، يَا ذَا العَرْشِ الْعَظِيمَ.
records.transliteration: fa'fʿal biy dhālika wa'in lam astawjibhu minka yā dhā al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīm
records.english_text: So do that for me though I merit it not from Thee, O Possessor of the Mighty Throne!

readings.title: 08. Seeking Refuge from Hateful Things
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَيَجَـانِ الْحِرْصِ ، وَسَوْرَةِ الغَضَبِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْحَسَدِ وضَعْفِ الصَّبْرِ وَقِلَّةِ الْقَنَاعَةِ وَشَكَاسَةِ الْخُلُقِ ، وَإلْحَاحِ الشَّهْوَةِ ، وَمَلَكَةِ الْحَمِيَّةِ ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min hayajāni al-hirṣi wa sawratil-ghadab wa ghalabatil-hasad wa ḍaʿfil-ṣabr wa qillatil qana'ati wa shakasatil khuluq wa'ilhāḥi al-shahwati, wa-malakati al-ḥamiyyah
records.english_text: O God, I seek refuge in Thee from the agitation of craving, the violence of wrath, the domination of envy, the frailty of patience, the lack of contentment, surliness of character, urgency of passion, the disposition to vehemence,

records.arabic_text: وَمُتَابَعَةِ الْهَوَى ، وَمُخَالَفَةِ الْهُدَى ، وَسِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ ، وَتَعَاطِي الْكُلْفَةِ ، وَإيْثَارِ الْبَاطِلِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَالإصْرَارِ عَلَى الْمَأثَمِ ، وَاسْتِصْغَـارِ الْمَعْصِيَـةِ ، وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الطَّاعَةِ ،
records.transliteration: wa mutābaʿati al-hawā, wa mukhālafati al-hudā wa sinati al-ghaflah, wa ta'atii al-kulfah wa ʾīthāri l-bāṭili ʿalā l-ḥaqqi wal-iṣrāri ʿalā l-maʾṯami wa-istiṣghāri al-maʿṣiyati, wa-istikhtāri al-ṭāʿati
records.english_text: following caprice, opposing guidance, the sleep of heedlessness, undertaking the toilsome, preferring falsehood over truth, persisting in sin, making little of disobedience, making much of obedience,

records.arabic_text: وَمُبَاهَاةِ الْمُكْثِرِينَ ، وَالإزْرآءِ بِالْمُقِلِّينَ ، وَسُوءِ الْوِلاَيَةِ لِمَنْ تَحْتَ أَيْدِينَا وَتَرْكِ الشُّكْرِ لِمَنِ اصْطَنَعَ الْعَارِفَةَ عِنْدَنَا ، أَوْ أَنْ نَعْضُدَ ظَالِماً ، أَوْ نَخْذُلَ مَلْهُوفاً ،
records.transliteration: wa mubāhāti l-mukthirīna, wa al-izrāʾi bil-muqillīna wa suu'il-wilāyati liman tahta aydeena wa tarqil shukri limani istana'a al-'arifata 'indana aw an naʿḍuda ẓāliman, aw nakhẓula malhūfan
records.english_text: vying with the wealthy, distitleging the poor, guarding badly over those in our hands, failing to thank those who have done good to us, aiding a wrongdoer, abandoning someone troubled,

records.arabic_text: أَوْ نَرُومَ مَا لَيْسَ لَنَا بِحَقّ، أَوْ نَقُولَ فِي الْعِلْمِْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْم
records.transliteration: aw narooma ma laysa lana bihaqqa aw naqūla fī al-ʿilm bi-ghayr ʿilm
records.english_text: wanting what is not rightfully ours, and speaking about knowledge without knowing.

records.arabic_text: وَنَعُـوذُ بِـكَ أَنْ نَنْطَوِيَ عَلَى غِشِّ أَحَد ، وَأَنْ نُعْجَبَ بِأَعْمَالِنَا ، وَنَمُدَّ فِي آمَالِنَا ،
records.transliteration: wa-naʿuẓu bi-ka an nanṭawiya ʿalā ghishshi aḥad wa'an nuʿjaba bi-aʿmālinā, wa namudda fī āmālinā
records.english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from harbouring dishonesty toward anyone, being pleased with our works, and stretching out our expectations.

records.arabic_text: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ السَّرِيرَةِ ، وَاحْتِقَارِ الصَّغِيرَةِ ، وَأَنْ يَسْتَحْوِذَ عَلَيْنَا الشَّيْطَانُ ، أَوْ يَنْكُبَنَـا الزَّمَانُ ، أَوْ يَتَهَضَّمَنَا السُّلْطَانُ.
records.transliteration: wa naʿūḏu bika min suu'i al-sarīra, wa-iḥtiqāri al-ṣaghīra wa'an yastahwizu 'alayna ash-shaytan 'aw yankubanna al-zamanu, 'aw yatahadhamana al-sultanu
records.english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from ill-mindedness, looking down on the small, Satan's gaining mastery over us, time's afflicting us, and the sovereign's oppressing us.

records.arabic_text: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ تَنَاوُلِ الإسْرَافِ ، وَمِنْ فِقْدَانِ الْكَفَـافِ
records.transliteration: wa-naʿūdh bi-ka min tanāwul al-isrāf, wa min fiqdan al-kafāf
records.english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from acting with prodigality and not having sufficiency.

records.arabic_text: وَنَعُوذُ بِـكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ وَمِنَ الْفَقْرِ إلَى الاَكْفَاءِ وَمِنْ مَعِيشَة فِي شِدَّة وَمَيْتَة عَلَى غَيْـرِ عُدَّة.
records.transliteration: wa naʿūdh bi-ka min shamātati al-aʿdā'i wa min al-faqr ilā al-akfāʾi wa min maʿīshat fī shiddah wa maytah ʿalā ghayr ʿuddah
records.english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from the gloating of enemies, indigent need for equals, living in hardship, and dying without readiness.

records.arabic_text: وَنَعُـوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْحَسْرَةِ الْعُظْمى ، وَالْمُصِيبَةِ الْكُبْرَى ، وَأَشْقَى الشَّقَآءِ وَسُوءِ المآبِ ، وَحِرْمَانِ الثَّوَابِ ، وَحُلُولِ الْعِقَابِ.
records.transliteration: wa naʿūdhu bika min al-ḥasrat al-ʿuẓmā wa-al-muṣībat al-kubrā, wa-ashqā al-shaqā' wa-sū'i al-māb wa hirmāni althawābi, wa ḥulūli alʿiqāb
records.english_text: We seek refuge in Thee from the most dreadful remorse, the greatest affliction, the most wretched wretchedness, the evil end to the journey, the deprivation of reward, and the advent of punishment.

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ، وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ ذَلِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيـعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa'a'ithni min kulli dhalika bi rahmatika wa jamiʿa al-mu'minīna wa al-mu'mināti
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and through Thy mercy, give to me refuge from all of that, and to all the faithful, both men and women!

records.arabic_text: يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
records.transliteration: yā ʾarḥama l-rāḥimīn
records.english_text: O Most Merciful of the merciful!
